title: The AI Iceberg Index: Sector & Role Exposure Across North America

industries.name: Information, Software & Media
industries.aiWipeoutRisk: Routine coding, QA boilerplate, localization, tier-1 support, and ad-ops scheduling.
industries.humanMoat: Systems architecture, novel product direction, proprietary data negotiation, and security accountability.

industries.name: Finance, Insurance & Real Estate
industries.aiWipeoutRisk: Underwriting packets, claims triage, KYC/AML document review, routine financial modeling, and reconciliation.
industries.humanMoat: Fiduciary sign-off, complex deal structuring, regulatory relationship management, and physical asset appraisal.

industries.name: Professional, Scientific & Technical
industries.aiWipeoutRisk: Junior legal discovery, contract redlining, standard CAD drafting, tax prep, and market-research synthesis.
industries.humanMoat: Wet-lab experimentation, courtroom advocacy, P.Eng. stamp liability, and ambiguous client problem-framing.

industries.name: Manufacturing (Advanced & Process)
industries.aiWipeoutRisk: ERP supply-chain scheduling, quality-log reporting, vendor invoicing, and routine BOM procurement.
industries.humanMoat: Line maintenance, die/tooling setup, physical process troubleshooting on the shop floor, and safety lockouts.

industries.name: Healthcare & Social Assistance
industries.aiWipeoutRisk: Medical coding (ICD-10), prior-authorization paperwork, intake transcription, and shift rostering.
industries.humanMoat: Bedside nursing, surgical & emergency intervention, physical therapy, and high-trust patient care.

industries.name: Public Administration & Government
industries.aiWipeoutRisk: Permit intake verification, benefits eligibility screening, freedom-of-information redaction, and case summaries.
industries.humanMoat: First-responder policing/fire, statutory adjudication, public hearings, and field inspections.

industries.name: Educational Services
industries.aiWipeoutRisk: Standardized grading, syllabus/worksheet drafting, admissions paperwork, and registrar scheduling.
industries.humanMoat: In-room classroom management, childhood socialization, hands-on lab instruction, and mentorship.

industries.name: Retail & Wholesale Trade
industries.aiWipeoutRisk: Call-center order tracking, catalog copywriting, demand forecasting sheets, and automated checkout.
industries.humanMoat: Floor merchandising, complex B2B technical sales, loss prevention, and last-yard stocking.

industries.name: Transportation, Warehousing & Utilities
industries.aiWipeoutRisk: Freight brokerage matching, customs manifest filing, dispatch routing, and billing audit.
industries.humanMoat: Heavy-haul driving in adverse weather, high-voltage line repair, marine/rail operations, and physical loading.

industries.name: Energy, Mining & Oil/Gas Extraction
industries.aiWipeoutRisk: Seismic log pre-screening, reservoir simulation setup, land-lease clerical compliance, and SCADA reporting.
industries.humanMoat: Rig/wellhead operations, pipeline maintenance, field geology, and hazardous-environment turnaround crews.

industries.name: Construction & Civil Infrastructure
industries.aiWipeoutRisk: Quantity takeoffs, routine bid estimation, RFIs, and progress-billing paperwork.
industries.humanMoat: Unstructured job-site carpentry, electrical, plumbing, ironwork, crane operation, and municipal inspection.

industries.name: Accommodation, Food & Recreation
industries.aiWipeoutRisk: Reservation bots, drive-thru voice ordering, and multi-property revenue pricing.
industries.humanMoat: Line cooking, table hospitality, housekeeping, live events, and culinary craft.

regions.name: Ontario (Toronto–Waterloo–Auto Corridor)
regions.signature: High submerged exposure in Bay Street back-office finance alongside protected auto/process manufacturing in southwestern Ontario.

regions.name: Alberta (Calgary–Edmonton–Oil Sands)
regions.signature: Field extraction and skilled trades anchor a high physical moat, while Calgary corporate/engineering headquarters carry the submerged AI exposure.

regions.name: British Columbia (Pacific Gateway)
regions.signature: Port logistics, natural resources, and construction balance urban software/VFX exposure in Vancouver.

regions.name: Quebec (Montreal–Aerospace & Hydro)
regions.signature: Strong AI research hub (Mila) paired with heavy aerospace/industrial manufacturing and public-sector services.

regions.name: California (Bay Area–SoCal–Central Valley)
regions.signature: Highest visible 'tip of the iceberg' (4.8%) due to Silicon Valley, plus large submerged exposure in entertainment, legal, and financial ops.

regions.name: Texas (Houston–DFW–Austin Triangle)
regions.signature: DFW/Austin corporate & tech hubs create mid-tier cognitive exposure, buffered by Gulf Coast energy, refining, and construction.

regions.name: New York & Tri-State Corridor
regions.signature: Highest submerged Iceberg exposure (15.8%): dense concentration of financial analysis, compliance, legal, and administrative roles.

regions.name: Great Lakes Manufacturing Belt (MI/OH/IL/IN)
regions.signature: The classic Iceberg case highlighted by ORNL: low visible tech-sector share (1.6%), but 7.4x larger submerged exposure in plant administration, supply chain, and insurance.

regions.name: New England (Boston Biotech & Hartford Finance)
regions.signature: High white-collar density in insurance, asset management, and university administration alongside protected wet-lab R&D.

regions.name: Pacific Northwest (Seattle–Portland)
regions.signature: Second-highest visible tech exposure (4.4%) from hyperscale cloud & software HQs, contrasted with aerospace machining and maritime trade.

regions.name: US Southeast (Atlanta–Charlotte–Florida)
regions.signature: Charlotte banking and Atlanta corporate back-offices drive submerged clerical exposure; hospitality and construction remain physical.

regions.name: Mountain & Plains (CO/UT/NM/KS)
regions.signature: National laboratories, aerospace engineering, and resource extraction balance mid-level administrative exposure.
